title: [Master] - Move Expense Agent (Preview) app into BCApps
summary: The Expense Agent app (preview) is now integrated into BCApps, providing AI-powered expense management capabilities including approval workflows, report handling, and API endpoints for integration with external systems.
key_points: Adds expense management module with AI agent capabilities for automating expense workflows and approvals
Provides 50+ API pages for expense data access and management including reports, itemizations, and participants
Introduces role-based permission sets for agents and admins alongside core business entity tables
Includes localized event subscribers for multiple regions (AT, AU, CA, DE, DK, ES, FR, GB, NZ, US)
Supports agent consumption tracking, KPI monitoring, and email-based task scheduling features
